name: commonsdb-integration-tests
description: Integration tests for CommonsDB B2B API - ingest, search, and metadata endpoints

scripts.generate-keys: openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out api_test_ec_private_key.pem && openssl ec -in api_test_ec_private_key.pem -pubout -out api_test_ec_public_key.pem
scripts.setup: cp env.template .env && echo 'Created .env file. Please edit it with your values.'
